title: Accumulate with Running Total
code:
def running_sum(numbers):
    total = 0
    history = []
    for n in numbers:
        total += n
        history.append(total)
    return history

In-Place List Reversal with Pointers
code:
def reverse_array(arr):
    left = 0
    right = len(arr) - 1
    while left < right:
        arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1

Interleave Two Slices
code:
def interleave(first, second):
    result = []
    for a, b in zip(first, second):
        result.append(a)
        result.append(b)
    rem = first[len(second):] or second[len(first):]
    result.extend(rem)
    return result
